issues: The doctrinal_or_story_notes state that Nephi is identified as narrator, but the supplied verses do not establish that identification. The source-only rule does not permit presenting it as fact.
The addressee in verse 11 is only identified as “my first-born in the wilderness”; the scene correctly leaves the identity unspecified, but depicting a particular person would remain uncertain.
The contrast of fruit and tree is grounded in the text, but any visual symbolism or portrayal of them is unspecified.
